Ravi (PM): quick decision needed 1: our enterprise pilot for Acmetix is asking to expand MVP scope. TL;DR: pick a safe cut so we hit the demo next Wed.
Lina (Eng): what did Acmetix specifically request?
Ravi (PM): 3 asks: (1) tenant-level quotas + simple alerts; (2) encrypted audit streaming to their SIEM (not search UI); (3) a low-latency mode that clamps context to 256 tokens for certain tenants.
Tess (Design): alert UX can be inline with quota toggle. tiny banner and toast for quota hits.
Lina (Eng): engineering roughs: quotas + alerts ~4 dev days + 1 test day; audit streaming (just push to customer endpoint) ~5 dev days if we reuse existing webhook path; low-latency clamp + config ~2 days.
Oscar (SRE): infra note: audit streaming to external SIEM requires network egress policy and credential rotation. add 2 infra days and an extra security review.
Priya (Data): metrics impact: quotas will generate new cardinality on tenant metrics. suggest sampling quotas events for first 30 days to avoid blowup.
Ravi (PM): proposed cut: MVP includes quotas toggle + basic alert emails, and low-latency clamp for pilots. Defer searchable audit UI and full SIEM integration to v1 (but allow streaming in a limited opt-in for Acmetix if security signs off).
Lina (Eng): that seems reasonable. if we gate the SIEM stream behind a feature flag and rate-limit it, we can enable a limited push without full infra work.
Oscar (SRE): we can allow outbound to customers' SIEMs via a scoped gateway cert, but needs cert automation. can be scoped to a single tenant for the pilot.
Tess (Design): UI language for demo: "Quota enforced: requests above X will be throttled. Reduced context mode active for selected tenants." keeps it simple.
Ravi (PM): launch criteria checklist (proposed):
- core generation endpoints stable under pilot load
- quota toggle implemented + basic alerting
- low-latency clamp config exposed per-tenant
- audit event sampler active (30d default)
- security signoff for SIEM stream (pilot-only)
If any item fails, demo moves to "feature preview" and we show screenshot + recording.
Lina (Eng): timeline: if we start today, quotas + clamp + tests by Tue EOD. SIEM pilot path needs security signoff; assume +3 days for certs.
Priya (Data): i'll add a sampling config (default 10%) and dashboard for quota hits. ETA 2 days.
Ravi (PM): tradeoffs we discussed:
- keeping SIEM streaming out of MVP reduces infra & compliance risk but means Acmetix sees less immediate value.
- shipping quotas now gives them control and reduces operational load for us.
- low-latency clamp hurts model quality for long-context flows; we should document known regressions for demo.

Launch-bot: Milestone update: demo-next-wed window reserved. Checklist created.

Lina (Eng): action items assigned: quotas feature (Lina) ETA +3d, clamp mode (Lina) ETA +2d, audit sampler (Priya) ETA +2d, SIEM pilot opt-in (Oscar) pending certs.
Ravi (PM): I'll prepare the customer playbook and the "what's missing in full product" slide for the demo.
Oscar (SRE): heads up 1: if SIEM pilot is needed earlier, we need an emergency security review slot. booking one now.
Tess (Design): pushing mockups to the demo repo in an hour.
Priya (Data): pushing dashboard draft to dashboards/team.
Ravi (PM): final call: we accept the cutline: MVP = quotas + basic alerts + sampler + clamp. v1 = full audit UI + SSO + region pinning + SIEM GA.
Lina (Eng): agreed. starting work now, will post quick diffs.
Ravi (PM): thanks team. daily standups here until demo. :rocket:
